mechanism_narrative: A low and stable federal funds rate (below 0.5%) indicates accommodative monetary policy, which reduces the cost of capital and boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 9.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 9.5%, or the Rank IC is negative over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates strong aggregate demand, which supports corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS are rising, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a manufacturing slowdown (INDPRO below 95), industrial production contraction signals reduced corporate output and potential earnings pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is below 95, or the Rank IC for the regime condition is negative over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS above 130,000 thousand) indicates a robust labor market, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS exceeds 130,000, or the Rank IC is below 0.04 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is at the zero lower bound (FEDFUNDS <= 0.25%), the central bank's limited room for further rate cuts increases the risk of a recession, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is at or below 0.25%, or the Rank IC for the regime condition is negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) indicates stable or deflationary conditions, which reduce the risk of monetary tightening and support equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL is below 220, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low interest rates (FEDFUNDS <= 0.25%) and high unemployment (UNRATE >= 9.5%) indicates a liquidity trap, where monetary policy is ineffective and the economy is in a recession, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS <= 0.25 and UNRATE >= 9.5, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
